card.name: Hyphen or M before 'mer' words
card.fires_on: The letter M or a hyphen just before a word starting with 'mer', most strongly in 6-mercaptopurine. It also fires on the M that starts words like Merciful, Meridian and mares.

modes.label: 6-Mercaptopurine
modes.description: The hyphen or M after the 6 in 6-mercaptopurine or 6-MP.

modes.label: Other mer- words
modes.description: An M or hyphen leading into other words that begin with mer, such as Merciful, Meridian or mares.

card.writes: It promotes text pieces spelling 'mer' and 'merc', pushing the model to continue with mer- words such as mercaptopurine.
card.plain: It spots the start of a mer- word, especially the M in 6-mercaptopurine, and prepares the model to write 'mer'.
